children.name: Article Title
children.text: Run a telemetry provider on Kubernetes

children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Deploy a standalone Gameplane telemetry receiver with TLS, a private dashboard and proof-of-work, using plain manifests.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Most operators do not need this: installs report to the project's provider by default.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Run it in its own namespace, gameplane-telemetry, on k3s or any cluster with Traefik, cert-manager and a Cloudflare zone.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: cert-manager issues the certificate through a Cloudflare DNS-01 challenge.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: A CNI that enforces NetworkPolicies (the kube-router that ships with k3s does).

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Secrets and trusted proxies, certificate issuer, then the receiver, Service, Ingress and NetworkPolicy.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: One replica with Recreate; the SQLite database lives on a PVC at /data.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: The Ingress publishes only the public listener, never the dashboard on :8081.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: NetworkPolicy: 8080 from Traefik, 8081 from monitoring, no egress.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Check readiness, the proof-of-work challenge and the client address; open the dashboard over port-forward.
